Class OmieServiceOrderBillingProvider

Namespace
NuvTools.Payment.Omie.ApiClient.Services
Assembly
NuvTools.Payment.Omie.ApiClient.dll

Invoicing of a single service order in Omie — the documented path to issue the NFS-e of one OS, which IOmieApiClient does not cover and therefore goes through the direct client:

  1. StatusOS (servicos/os/): fiscal state of the order — stage, whether it was cancelled, whether it was already invoiced and the NFS-e that came out of it. It is the query that says whether there is anything to do, and the one that confirms the result afterwards.
  2. ValidarOS (servicos/osp/): Omie's validation before invoicing. It is what points out, in the API's own words, which required data is missing on the order or on the client registration — instead of finding out through the city hall's rejection, after the invoice was already requested.
  3. FaturarOS (servicos/osp/): invoices that order. The equivalent of "Faturar Selecionada" in the Omie UI — not to be confused with FaturarLoteOS (servicos/oslote/), which invoices every order of a stage and, triggered for one client, would take the others along.

None of them invents data: the invoice content is the order's. What is decided here is only when to ask for the invoice.

GetStatusAsync(string, CancellationToken)

Fiscal state of the order by integration code. Returns null in Data when the order does not exist in Omie — absence is not a failure: it is the case of whoever has not created the order yet.

ValidateAsync(long, string, CancellationToken)

Validates the order for invoicing (ValidarOS). A failure carries Omie's own text, which is what knows the missing required data — passing it through raw is more useful than translating it by approximation.
